# XMP import contract fixtures

These ten small XMP files were hand-authored with synthetic settings. They validate parsing and numeric mappings and contain no customer files.

The darktable parameter layouts follow the existing Frameleaf control adapter and darktable commit `20891f6c6fa7be995e5bf9dff9d1ee5062051773`, specifically `src/iop/exposure.c`, `temperature.c`, `crop.c`, `clipping.c`, `colorbalancergb.c` and `ashift.c`. Unknown modules and versions remain in the imported recipe envelope.

The fixtures do not qualify visual equivalence. Mean delta E acceptance needs authentic source images, XMP and independently rendered Lightroom/darktable reference JPEGs. No reference JPEGs or image quality result are supplied here.
